thought.text: The auth uses `params[:username]`, not `params[:login]`! My test sent `login` which was ignored. Let me check the `Auth` class to confirm the parameter name and the verified handling:

reasoning_content:
Found it! The `authenticate_with_password` method uses `Auth.new(params[:username], params[:password], ...)`. The parameter name is `username`, not `login`! My curl used `"login":"admin@example.com"` but the API expects `username`. So my test was wrong — the password is probably correct, but I sent the field under the wrong name (`login` instead of `username`), so `params[:username]` was nil and login failed.

Let me check the `Auth` class to confirm the expected parameter name.
